Neel Agarwal
neel.agarwal759@example.com | +91 9360150726 | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented accounting professional with progressive experience across accounting operations and finance systems, plus prior experience developing automation solutions. Skilled at improving month-end processes, ensuring regulatory compliance, and implementing automation to reduce manual effort. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Tally, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Agile, Linux, Git

Work Experience

Senior Accountant, Vertex Analytics (Mar 2022 - Present)
- Managed GST compliance for multiple client entities, prepared and filed monthly returns and reconciliations using Tally, reducing filing discrepancies by 30%.
- Performed TDS computations and filings for payroll and vendor payments, implemented standardized schedules that lowered TDS query volumes by 25%.
- Streamlined accounts workflows in Tally to accelerate month-end close, improving reporting turnaround by 20% while maintaining audit-ready records.

Finance Executive, Tata Consultancy Services (May 2018 - Feb 2022)
- Handled Accounts Payable activities for vendor invoice processing, implementing controls that shortened invoice-to-payment cycle by 18% while maintaining SOX-aligned documentation.
- Coordinated GST invoice verification and input tax credit reconciliations for service contracts across multiple states, resolving mismatches and recovering credits worth significant amounts.
- Collaborated with procurement and vendor teams to resolve payment disputes and enforce GST-compliant invoicing practices.

Power Platform Developer, Zoho (Mar 2016 - Apr 2018)
- Developed Power Automate workflows to automate repetitive data entry and approval routing, cutting manual processing time for finance teams by nearly 40%.
- Built prototypes using Microsoft Copilot Studio to assist users in generating routine reports and draft communications, improving user efficiency in an Agile delivery setup.
- Managed solution deployment and version control on Linux-based environments, maintaining code in Git and coordinating releases with stakeholders.

Education
BBA, Christ University
